system.description:
• Effect: Once per month, a day-long ritual weaving Distort Reality, Permanent Image and Polymorph Any Object together creates any single object, being (of Level up to half yours, with all its powers), or area of 10ft×10ft per level.
  • It cannot be dispelled for 1 day per level, except by a caster of your level or higher.
  • Only one can exist at a time.
  • Each work has a 1% chance per level of becoming permanently real: it can never be dispelled or disbelieved, and no longer counts as your one Magnum Opus

activities.name: Magnum Opus
activities.text: Perform a day-long ritual to create any single object, being or area, with a 1% chance per level that it becomes permanently real.
